properties.description:
ARRIVED 2026-09-12. The second half of the tool-surface pass Anthony ordered on 2026-09-11 ("run 6 and 7 together as one measurement-then-fix pass"); the findability half had already arrived at epoch:a-tool-says-when-you-would-ask-for-it. What remained was ACCURACY, and it was done from the measurement rather than from memory.

WHAT WAS MEASURED, from the committed goldens on the day: 24 descriptions under 220 characters; 76 of 230 required parameters across 68 tools publishing NO description at all (21 of them a constructor's own id); three one-offs from the blind prediction test; and docs/skills-and-tools.md — "generated from the running server" by hand, once, on 2026-08-21 — saying 21 skills and 155 tools against 26 and 180 served.

WHAT WAS DONE:
· All 76 parameters described, as doc comments on their request-struct fields, each a true sentence about what the field IS and where a caller gets one. The toolsnaps moved by exactly 76 insertions across 68 files — one line per parameter, the measurement to the number.
· A CLASS GATE, `every_required_parameter_is_described`, with DERIVED membership like its sibling `every_reference_parameter_names_its_type`: a 181st tool cannot ship an undescribed required parameter. Shown to fail on one stripped description before it was trusted. EXEMPT is empty and kept as a list, with a second test that refuses a stale entry.
· All 24 thin descriptions rewritten from purpose, under the 1,500-character budget skill_lint enforces — each saying what the tool computes, when to ask for it, and where it applies WHAT AN EMPTY ANSWER MEANS.
· The three one-offs, from what the sweep actually observed: TWO WERE ALREADY CLOSED by #477/#478 and the tracker was stale (get_node says which null via `empty_because`; both ledgers name conformance, stale_verification and unknown_verification_freshness). The third, compose_and_analyse's empty seam on a seam built for it, is a ROOT CAUSE — the namespacing that prevents id collisions also keeps the two halves from touching — so its description now states that limit honestly and points at pair_designs; the cause itself stays open as its own item.
· docs/skills-and-tools.md regenerated by a new instrument, tools/render_skills_and_tools.py, which rewrites the tool rows and counts from the committed toolsnaps and leaves the prose alone; `--check` is a CI gate, shown to fail on an altered row. The document now says what it claimed to be.

⭐ THE CATCH, AND IT IS THE LESSON OF THE INCREMENT: the findability acceptance corpus from the previous half FAILED on the first rewrite — 8 of 180 tools fell out of their top 5. Six had lost the one sentence stating the job in a user's words ("remove an item from the design", "this release runs in that environment", "offers that interface"): rewriting "from purpose" had paraphrased it away, which is exactly the discipline dec:a-tool-carries-the-users-phrasing-and-the-corpus-is-the-test exists to hold. Two others, untouched, slid to rank 6 as their neighbours grew. Putting the sentence back recovered all eight — 180 of 180, and scan_nodes rose INTO the top 5 so its rank-6 exemption came out. The held-out paraphrase set, the honesty check, reads 34 of 42 from 36: no query newly misses; two former passes sit at ranks 6–8 and one former miss rose to rank 8. Stated, and deliberately NOT tuned to (fact:after-the-description-pass-180-of-180-reach-the-top-five-and-the-held-out-set-reads-34-of-42). Accuracy and findability are one surface, and a description can be made truer and less findable in the same edit.

WHAT IT DOES NOT CLAIM: that the descriptions are GOOD. The gates pin presence, consistency and findability; quality is the blind prediction test, which is a judgement, and the next sweep is what measures whether this pass moved it.

NO VERSION NUMBER BY DESIGN.
properties.name: A tool's description predicts what the tool does
